Name: CP Witch Hazel Tree
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
I wanted to add a Witch Hazel Tree to my game, it functions as a fruit tree. I'm figuring out how to create it as a wild tree just learning how to put it to spawn over the map. If anyone knows how let me know!

Witch Hazel Tree takes 28 days to fully grow, it blooms throughout the year besides winter. It produces Witch Hazel Blossoms.

You can buy the seed from Pierre’s shop 

With the Custom Tapper Framework,  I was able to make it where you can get Witch Hazel oil (Updated 4/26) with a tapper every 3 days but you can also drop 2 Witch Hazel Blossoms in a keg and distill it there (you can also change the time if you edit the config file)

Added to make witch hazel you still from keg, added witch hazel jelly (credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Cometkins [/url]for jar), a cooking recipe unlocked after farm level 1 of witch hazel tea.

* Note it looks a little funny with the tapper. Because the stump is slim.*

Let me know if you want me to add Witch Hazel Jelly or any other custom good to add.

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aimon111/mods]


Aimon111 [/url]created a custom tree for me and items, check them out for a commission!
